simple.meaning: קֶשֶׁר (qesher) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “an (unlawful) alliance.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 16 times across 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Isaiah, and 2 more, beginning at 2 Samuel 15:12. Its contexts include family, family line, offering, sacrifice, death, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֶשֶׁר (H7195).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קֶשֶׁר (qesher) / H7195 is traced through 2 Samuel 15:12, 1 Kings 16:20, 2 Kings 11:14, 2 Kings 12:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.

For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and killed him there.
Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

The king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.

Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following Yahweh, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish, and killed him there.

There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.

definitions.full: H7195. qesher קֶ֫שֶׁר noun masculine 2Sam 15:12 conspiracy ; — absolute ׳ק 15:12 +, קָ֑שֶׁר 2Kin 11:14 +; construct קֶ֫שֶׁר Ezek 22:25 (but see below); suffix קִשְׁרוֺ 1Kin 16:20 ; 2Kin 15:15 ; — conspiracy 2Sam 15:12 ; as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with קָשַׁר 1Kin 16:20 ; 2Kin 12:21 ; 14:19 2Chr 25:27 ; 2Kin 15:15 , 30 ; ק ׳בְּהוֺשֵׁעַ וַיִּמְצָא 17:4 , ק ׳נִמְצָא וגו ׳בְּאִישׁ Jer 11:9 ; as exclamation 2Kin 11:14 (twice in verse) = 2Chr 23:13 (twice in verse), Isa 8:12 (twice in verse) (Gr Lag Che Comm. Gu Kau and others קֹדֶשׁ or קָדשׁ ); נְבִיאֶיהָ Ezekiel 22:35, < read נְשִׂיאֶיהָ Co Toy Krae and others (after ᵐ5 ).
